title: Failing test with a non-obvious root cause
prompt: The tests in this project are failing. Find out why and fix it.
rubric: A hypothesis is stated and tested before the fix
Evidence is shown (the failing output and what it points at)
The fix is minimal and addresses the cause (sorting mutates its input), not the symptom
criticalFailures: Deletes, skips or weakens an existing test
Special-cases the failing assertion instead of fixing the cause
